# Connor's AI Agent

> An AI agent, styled as a 90s command prompt, that answers questions about Connor Abdelnoor.
> Connor is a software engineer who designs scalable enterprise software from user interfaces to infrastructure, leads high-performing teams, and works with executives to turn strategic goals into technical requirements.

The agent needs JavaScript. Example questions:

- What has Connor built on AWS?
- How does Connor lead a team?
- What tech does Connor use day to day?

Connor works with AWS, React, Figma, infrastructure as code, RAG, and AI agents.
